**Finding: MISSING (medium severity) — no HDI performance warranty**

Section 9 "Warranties" is limited to boilerplate mutual reps (corporate existence, authority, enforceability, no conflict) plus a Globix Agreement acknowledgement. HDI — which designs, develops, implements, hosts, operates and maintains the Site under Section 1 — gives no warranty as to the quality or conformance of that work, and there is no remedy clause. Notably, there is also no warranty disclaimer, so the insertion faces no competing "AS IS" language.

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** new Section 9(c) inserted after p0058 warranting (i) professional and workmanlike services, (ii) 12-month conformance of the Site/software to specifications and documentation, (iii) compliance with applicable law, and (iv) no viruses or malicious code — with a re-performance / repair-or-replace / refund remedy at HDI's option. Fallback of 90 days (software) / 30 days (services) flagged in the comment. Note that Section 9 already survives for two years post-termination under Section 10.7, so the new warranty gets the benefit of that survival.
